Hunter.prompt: Create one realistic videogame character texture source: a straight-on orthographic head and neck of a fictional gaunt middle-aged male with broad cheekbones. An eerie but entirely non-graphic undead character design. Intact unbroken pale grey-beige skin, fine wrinkles, pores, mottling, dirt, tired eyes, short dark hair stubble. Absolutely no wounds, blood, cuts, sores, exposed flesh or gore. Closed relaxed mouth and intact lips. Fully visible ears and complete head, no clothing, no accessories. Neutral even flat studio lighting, grey background. Entire head and neck centered on square canvas; top of skull at 5%, eye centers at 42%, mouth at 66%, chin at 85%; head spans 70% canvas width. A flat detailed colour source for Blender texturing.

Runner.prompt: Use case: game texture source / identity-preserving reference edit. Use the FIRST FRONT-VIEW character in the attached Runner turnaround sheet. Create a SINGLE square high-resolution front-facing HEAD AND UPPER NECK colour reference for this same zombie. Exactly one face, no duplicate views, no text, no labels, no border. This is a diffuse colour texture source to project onto an existing Blender zombie head, not a dramatic portrait. Preserve this character's distinctive face and ethnicity, facial proportions, age and infected appearance. Camera strictly straight-on orthographic, head perfectly upright and symmetric in orientation, mouth slightly parted with dark interior and a few worn teeth visible, eyes looking straight ahead. Neutral even shadowless cross-polarized studio lighting, no highlights, no rim light, no cast shadows. Natural detailed mottled pale skin, tiny pores, old healed scars, superficial decay, subtle veins and grime. No exposed organs, no graphic gore. Skin and facial detail should be sharp and physically realistic. Remove all headgear and hoods to expose the complete skull and both ears for texture use; hair only short stubble, because hair and hood are separate geometry in Blender. Plain muted warm grey background. Composition: entire bald/stubbled skull, ears and neck centered; skull top near 6 percent image height, eye centers near 39 percent height, mouth near 64 percent, jaw near 78 percent, neck base at 95 percent. Head occupies about 70 percent of image width, centered exactly. Identity: gaunt athletic face, tense predatory expression. Do not add clothing or armour. Colour texture reference only; no stylized cartoon features and no baked directional lighting.
